title: Reconcile torrent completion state after deleting downloaded data
description:
Astra review of main 3b2c4f5 against SPEC.md.

## Problem and evidence

engine/files.go:66 removes download data without invalidating affected retained torrent handles or piece completion. engine/engine.go:369 restarts the same handle.

An isolated local HTTP webseed reproduction completed a 143,360-byte torrent, called StopTorrent, deleted its file through Engine.RemoveDownload, then called StartTorrent. All operations succeeded. After one second, Started=true, Percent=100 and Downloaded=143360, while the file did not exist. A partial fixture stopped at 32,768/2,293,760 bytes, had its .part file deleted, and remained at 1.42% eight seconds after restart.

This is separate from the intentional protection against deleting active incomplete downloads. No live downloads or configuration were changed during review.

## Expected behavior and acceptance criteria

- Permitted deletion reconciles affected torrent storage and completion state, including deletion through parent folders.
- Restarting an affected torrent downloads missing content and reports progress consistent with actual available data.
- Cover completed-file and partial-file deletion with real isolated webseed regression tests, verifying restored bytes rather than flags alone.
- Preserve active-download deletion protection and unaffected torrents.

## References

SPEC.md §8 engine operations and §10 core download flow (lines 293, 304, 402).
engine/files.go:44–66; engine/engine.go:369–388.
Local review reproducers: /tmp/ct-spec-review-delete.go and /tmp/ct-spec-review-partial-delete.go. These temporary paths are supplemental; tests must be self-contained.
